next_actions: Email AddisAbaba@EducationUSA.org and book a free advising session
Register for the next available TOEFL iBT (target a July or August test date)
Ask 2 teachers (one science, one humanities) for letters of recommendation while school is still in session
Apply to the EducationUSA Scholars Program (ESP) for the next intake
Open a Common Application account at commonapp.org and start a school shortlist of 8–12 programs
Make sure your passport is valid through at least December 2027
Order an official transcript and an English-medium-instruction letter from your high school
Open a free Bold.org account and a Fastweb account; set up scholarship alerts
